description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for user details retrieval within an ASP.NET Core application, implementing a CQRS pattern with MediatR. It includes a Request class, Validator, and Handler to process user detail requests, fetch user data from the database, generate JWT tokens, and return user information.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: Contains the nested classes and logic for processing user detail queries.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents a request to fetch user details based on username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the Query request to ensure the username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query request, fetches user data, generates JWT token, and returns user details wrapped in UserEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming Query, retrieves user data, handles not found error, generates token, and returns user envelope.
